Current code update flow uses Targets Redfish property to route PLDM
package to pldmd or specific CodeUpdater. An alternate Redfish API usage
is if no Targets are specified, BMC matches the components in the single
PLDM package to the PLDM and Non-PLDM devices and updates all the
applicable devices. Additionally, if Targets are present, then the
specific Targets are updated using the firmware in the single composite
PLDM package.

The Targets can be used to update one or many components in the package. Once the package is forwarded to pldm daemon without the targets, pldm daemon cannot exclude the components which it should not update based on the Target list.
